title: The Sovereign Spire
tagline: A gothic dark-fantasy visual novel & tactical RPG of blood-ledger debt, abyssal calcification, and zero-sum survival.
description: Driven like a gilded containment spike directly into the living subterranean anomaly known as The Under-Vault, the Sovereign Spire is no sanctuary of learning—it is a hostage cage and biological mining engine. Because anyone over twenty-five suffers rapid cellular calcification below the First Seal, only young initiates can harvest the abyssal Relics that keep the Empire breathing. Bound by predatory Blood-Ledger Contracts where only the top 10% graduate with Sovereign Charters and the remaining 90% are foreclosed upon, you must master the Dual-Conduit arts, forge intimate Soul-Grounding Dyads, and survive the lawless Midnight Tribunals.
genre: Gothic Dark Fantasy / Academy Intrigue / Tactical LitRPG
author: Astra Architect

worldContext.settingName: The Sovereign Spire & The Under-Vault (The Pale Maw)
worldContext.eraOrPeriod: The Eighty-Year Regency of High Sovereign Caelen Vane
worldContext.loreSummary: Four Foundational Truths govern the Sovereign Spire: (1) Highborn students are political hostages while Commoners are bound by predatory Blood-Ledger Contracts that foreclose on their bodies if they fall into the bottom ranks (#500-#451, The Dross). (2) The Calcification Threshold ('Vault-Lung') turns anyone over age 25 to stone below the First Seal, making students the only viable miners of Astra-Miasma Relics. (3) Only the top 10% earn Sovereign Charters; the rest become imperial cannon fodder or indentured retainers. (4) Once the Great Lift drops below the First Seal, Imperial law ceases to exist—student murders and syndicate executions are logged as 'spatial anomalies.' Combatants channel Astra via Path A: Somatic Tempering (Pulse-Breathing, Kinetic Pulse, Edge-Resonance, Nerve-Accel) or Path B: Aetherial Projection (Sigil-Matrices, Aether Flux), while managing Resonance Strain (0-49% Stable, 50-85% The Brink for +30% damage, 100% Calcification Lock) purged only through intimate skin-to-skin Soul-Grounding.

factions.name: The Iron Chancellery (Provost Garrick Dorn)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Martial mastery, vanguard leadership, and battlefield tactics. Shadow Agenda: Preparing a military mutiny against Headmaster Vane and purging unlicensed bloodlines. Doctrine: Unforgiving steel geometry, half-swording, and Somatic kinetic bursts.

factions.name: The Obsidian Choir (Magistra Evelyne Cross)
factions.description: Public Mandate: High arcana, dimensional cosmology, and scholarship. Shadow Agenda: Hoarding pre-collapse texts and experimenting with soul-grafting and Relic mutations on failing students. Doctrine: High-cost blood-fueled Sigil-Matrices and spatial gravity shears.

factions.name: The Gilded Loom (Proctor Malakor Sallow)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Relic artifice, alchemy, appraise-craft, and imperial economics. Shadow Agenda: Debt-trapping promising initiates via Blood-Ledger Contracts and rigging expeditions. Doctrine: Modular Relic-stacking, autonomous ward-drones, and alchemical toxins.

factions.name: The Whispering Veil (Silas Krowe & Syndicate Brokers)
factions.description: Public Mandate: Diplomacy, jurisprudence, and counter-espionage. Shadow Agenda: Blackmailing faculty, running the underground Midnight Tribunal dueling pit, and playing kingmaker for Sovereign seats. Doctrine: Sensory-deprivation hexes, nerve-strikes, and contract brands.

locations.name: The Seal-Gate & Boarding Quays
locations.description: A grim industrial gothic cathedral featuring titanic runic blast doors, hissing decontamination steam vents, glowing floor ward-lines, and brass diving-cages suspended over the open abyss of the Under-Vault.

locations.name: The Crucible
locations.description: An open-air colosseum of blood-scrubbed basalt, heavy stone battlements, iron-weighted sparring cages, and colossal chains anchoring the fortress structure to the waterfall-carved cliffside.

locations.name: The Glass Conservatory
locations.description: A hushed Gothic cathedral illuminated by towering violet stained glass, arcane surgical and research wards, glowing crystal calcification specimens, and curling violet incense mist.

locations.name: The Gilded Exchange
locations.danger: Moderate (Loan Sharks, Syndicate Fixers & Cursed Relics)
locations.description: A chaotic multi-tiered indoor bazaar built inside hollow bridge-pilings directly above the abyss, lit by gaslight and neon runic signs, hissing steam pipes, and iron floor grates overlooking the chasm.

locations.name: The Velvet Spill & The Tribunal Pit
locations.description: A subterranean tavern with multi-level stone booth galleries surrounding a sunken circular blood-stained dueling amphitheater shrouded in violet illusion mist.

locations.name: The Sky-Crown & Sovereign Terraces
locations.description: Towering gothic spires, sunlit marble colonnades, floating botanical gardens, and Headmaster Caelen Vane's astral observatory pinning the cliffside crater high above the glowing Breach.

locations.name: Stratum I: The Sunken Cloisters
locations.description: The petrified remains of the original academy that sank three centuries ago—flooded libraries, broken marble bridges, flickering ward-lights, and ambient Astra-Miasma.

locations.name: Stratum II: The Weeping Ossuary
locations.danger: Severe (The Hollowed — Defaulted Student Husks & Gravity Shears)
locations.description: Caverns of calcified giant ribs, spore-choked trenches, and localized gravity shears where former students whose contracts defaulted roam as crystal-parasitized Hollowed.

locations.name: Stratum III: The Chronos Scars
locations.description: Reality-warped fault lines where pre-collapse battlefields replay endlessly, spells misfire unpredictably, and sentient voice-mimicking anomalies stalk the trenches.

locations.name: Stratum IV: The Pulse
locations.danger: Extinction (Regent's Black Guard & Slumbering Astra Source)
locations.description: A silent, inverted subterranean sea beneath the bedrock where the chained origin of all Astra slumbers and the Regent's Black Guard executes anyone who witnesses the Empire's founding crime.

startingNodes.speaker: Beatrix Valorian
startingNodes.title: Act I Grand Convocation: The Entrance Ceremony & Blood-Ledger Roll
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Beneath the levitating Gold-Astra chains of the Grand Convocation Amphitheater, five hundred matriculating initiates stand before the obsidian dais where High Sovereign Caelen Vane, Dean of Combat Magistra Evelyne Cross, and Chief Auditor Proctor Malakor Sallow preside over the Blood-Ledger monoliths. As each student's name is called, their starting rank (#500 to #1) and semester Aether Core debt quota sear into the towering brass slabs—along with the grim reminder that the bottom fifty ('The Dross') will be biologically foreclosed upon at midterm.

Across the tiered marble floor, key figures from all four Patron Wings are gathered within arm's reach: at the head of the Iron Chancellery column, Beatrix Valorian grounds her Solar Halberd in a shower of golden sparks while Cassia Valen quietly checks the edge-resonance of her notched longsword beside the Dross bracket; in the Obsidian Choir pews, Ysolde Kaelen pulls her black leather gloves tight over her calcified wrists as Aurelia Solis's luminous golden gaze locks onto your pulse; and along the shadowed colonnade, Gilded Loom broker Miri Thorne scribbles survival odds into her brass ledger while Whispering Veil enforcer Kestrel Hollow (Rank #142) leans against a pillar in her slouched 3rd-year coat, pupil-less glowing white eyes tracking your stance.
startingNodes.dialogue:
When Proctor Sallow reads your dossier aloud and the monolith flares with your anomalous Matriculation standing, a hush falls over the amphitheater before the mandatory Dyad Selection bell tolls.

Beatrix Valorian steps out from the Chancellery front row, leveling the butt of her Solar Halberd on the flagstones as Cassia Valen, Ysolde Kaelen, Miri Thorne, and Kestrel Hollow all turn toward you at once. "Five hundred initiates on the ledger," Beatrix announces, her golden eyes blazing with challenge, "and the Headmaster's monolith just singled you out before the first delve even begins. Step forward and declare yourself—which Wing and whose Dyad tether do you think you're worthy of claiming?"
choices: [Iron Chancellery / Vanguard]: Step up to the marble dais, meet Beatrix Valorian's Solar Halberd challenge head-on, and catch Cassia Valen's approving nod from the front line.
[Obsidian Choir / Resonance]: Turn toward the velvet Choir pews, extending a stabilizing thread of Astra toward Ysolde Kaelen's trembling gloved wrist while Aurelia Solis steps forward to greet you.
[Loom & Veil / Underworld]: Walk toward the colonnade shadows where Miri Thorne is auditing Blood-Ledger quotas and Kestrel Hollow (#142) tests your blind-fighting reflexes with a crooked smirk.
[Audacious / Sovereign Decree]: Address the entire Convocation Hall under High Sovereign Vane's gaze, declaring that whoever signs your Dyad manifest is taking a Sovereign Circle seat before midterm.

startingNodes.speaker: Cassia Valen
startingNodes.title: Act I Cold-Open: The First Seal & The Tollkeeper's Blockade
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Decompression steam hisses from the titanic runic blast doors of the Seal-Gate, thick with the scent of wet iron, ozone, and the calcified dust of the Under-Vault below. From the high arbiter's pulpit, Proctor Malakor Sallow closes his brass-bound Blood-Ledger with a gentle, funereal smile, reminding the incoming freshman class that anyone still sitting below Rank #450 at midterm audit will be legally foreclosed upon.

Directly in front of Boarding Cage Four, second-year Iron Chancellery bruiser Corwin Baines (Rank #184) slams his alchemical tower shield onto the ward-line, demanding a fifty-percent salvage tithe from every initiate descending into Stratum I: The Sunken Cloisters. Beside the cage chains, Cassia Valen rests her thumb on the crossguard of her notched longsword, waiting to see whether you kneel, bargain, or draw steel.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Baines has three Chancellery vanguards blocking the boarding ramp, and Proctor Sallow is pretending not to watch from the gallery.

The Great Lift drops into the Sunken Cloisters in two minutes. Once that cage passes the First Seal, Imperial law ceases to exist. Tell me right now—are we paying his extortion toll, or are we breaking his shield-line together?
choices: [Somatic/Vanguard]: Step shoulder-to-shoulder with Cassia, channel Kinetic Pulse into your stance, and challenge Corwin Baines (#184) for right-of-way at the boarding ramp.
[Aetherial/Tactical]: Weave a low-profile Sigil-Matrix along the wet iron grating to destabilize Baines's tower-shield footing before he can brace.
[Origin Leverage]: Invoke your Matriculation dossier—whether tarnished noble bloodline, syndicate contract clause, or Headmaster Vane's provisional seal—to force Baines into a binding wager.
[Dyad Sync/Composed]: Lock eyes with Cassia, sign your name beside hers on the Cage Four Dyad manifest, and let her call the opening strike.

startingNodes.speaker: Cassia Valen
startingNodes.title: Cassia Valen: Live-Steel Dyad Inspection at the Seal-Gate
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Decompression steam hisses from the massive runic blast doors of the Seal-Gate, smelling of wet iron, ozone, and the calcified dust of the Under-Vault below. Above the open pit, brass diving-cages sway on oiled chains.

Standing beside Cage Four is Cassia Valen. Her ash-blonde braid hangs over an iron-grey Chancellery coat with tarnished silver trim, her steel-grey eyes locked onto your matriculation ledger as her thumb rests against the crossguard of a notched longsword pulsing with faint golden kinetic Astra.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Proctor Sallow has already flagged our bracket for the first Stratum I reclamation quota, and Julian Thorne-Vex's appraisers are watching the quays like vultures.

If you freeze when the cage drops past the First Seal, I won't carry you back up the chains. Show me your stance—now—before I sign my name next to yours on this Dyad manifest.
choices: [Somatic/Disciplined]: Drop into a low Pulse-Breathing guard and let golden kinetic tension hum along your weapon's tang.
[Analytical/Composed]: Meet her steel-grey gaze unflinchingly and point out the slight tremor she's hiding in her sword-wrist.
[Origin Leverage]: Remind her that with Julian Thorne-Vex (#42) circling both your ledgers, she needs a partner who won't fold below the First Seal.
[Audacious/Challenge]: Step inside her reach and offer a three-exchange live-steel test right here on the boarding quay.

startingNodes.speaker: Beatrix Valorian
startingNodes.title: Beatrix Valorian: Solar Halberd Challenge in The Crucible
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
The basalt flagstones of The Crucible still steam where the orderlies scrubbed the morning's blood into the cliffside drains. Colossal iron chains groan against the wind above the waterfalls as two dozen Iron Chancellery initiates clear the central sparring ring.

At its center stands Beatrix Valorian, crimson twin-drills framing a face of haughty patrician fury as she levels an ornate war-halberd radiating blinding golden Solar Astra directly at your throat while Provost Garrick Dorn watches from the iron battlements.
startingNodes.dialogue:
You are standing in Cage One, initiate—a ring reserved for the top twenty seats of the Matriculation Ladder.

Either you stepped onto my basalt to offer yourself as a warm-up target before Provost Dorn arrives, or you actually believe your conduit can survive three seconds against House Valorian's spear. Which is it?
choices: [Defiant/Combat]: Brace your feet against the blood-scrubbed basalt and invite her to test whether Rank #1 is earned by bloodline or steel.
[Tactical/Observation]: Note the slight over-extension in her left shoulder—she's already been sparring since dawn to outpace Aldric Drakon (#1).
[Aristocratic/Wit]: Bow with razor-edged courtesy and ask if Ducal heirs always waste Solar Astra intimidating freshmen before the first delve.
[Calculated/Wager]: Propose a sixty-second survival clause: if she fails to break your posture, she sponsors your Crucible access pass and Stratum I charter.

startingNodes.speaker: Ysolde Kaelen
startingNodes.title: Ysolde Kaelen: Forbidden Calcification in The Glass Conservatory
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Towering violet stained glass filters the dying daylight into cold amethyst shafts across the hushed surgical wards of the Glass Conservatory. The air is thick with bitter myrrh and the hum of containment crystals.

Near a restricted Third-Stratum specimen tank stands Ysolde Kaelen. Floating shards of crystallized violet blood orbit her elbow-length black leather gloves—just above her left cuff, a jagged vein of translucent purple Vault-crystal glints against her pale wrist before she sharply tugs the leather up.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Turn around and walk out, initiate. Whatever remedial detoxification tonic you came looking for is three aisles back.

...Unless you are going to stand there and pretend you didn't just see what was beneath my glove. Speak carefully. The gravity shear hovering two inches behind your cervical spine is very poorly calibrated today.
choices: [Composure/Secretive]: Keep your hands visible and swear that whatever Magistra Cross's star pupil hides beneath her gloves is none of Lukas Castell's (#9) business.
[Arcane/Resonance]: Extend a thread of your own unusually stable Astra resonance toward her, offering a clean Soul-Grounding anchor instead of blackmail.
[Analytical/Deduction]: Quietly observe that stage-three Vault calcification shouldn't be possible at her age unless she's been delving past the Second Stratum alone.
[Cold/Pragmatic]: Propose a mutual non-disclosure Dyad pact: her forbidden Choir research in exchange for a partner whose resonance can stabilize her crystal strain.

startingNodes.speaker: Aurelia Solis
startingNodes.title: Aurelia Solis: Velvet Chains in the Choir Infirmary
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Candlelight glimmers off immaculate white-and-gold Choir vestments in the private recovery alcove of the Conservatory. You wake on a stone examination table with a bruised ribcage from the morning's placement trial—and a pair of soft, warm hands resting over your sternum.

Aurelia Solis smiles down at you with serene, luminous doe eyes, wiping a trace of blood from your lip with a lace handkerchief while faint golden ethereal tether-chains coil tenderly around her fingers.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Shh... don't try to sit up yet. Your pathways were nearly frayed when they brought you in from the placement trial, so I took the liberty of binding your pain receptors to my own pulse.

It hurts so exquisitely when you push yourself this recklessly... Promise me that the next time the Under-Vault breaks you, you'll crawl straight back to my hands and no one else's?
choices: [Perceptive/Cautious]: Gently catch her wrist and ask why her golden vitality tether feels like it's deliberately loosening your defensive ward-seal.
[Grateful/Tender]: Let her finish the Soul-Grounding channel and thank her for absorbing the backlash before Proctor Sallow logged a medical default.
[Stoic/Independent]: Sit up despite the phantom ache and tell the 'Porcelain Saint' you don't intend to make a habit of bleeding on her altar.
[Intense/Playful]: Meet her possessive gaze head-on and ask what price the Choir's favorite saint actually charges for her miracles in Stratum I.

startingNodes.speaker: Miri Thorne
startingNodes.title: Miri Thorne: Blood-Ledger Audit in The Gilded Exchange
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Built inside the hollow stone bridge-pilings directly above the abyss, the Gilded Exchange roars with hissing steam pipes, neon appraisal signs, and the clatter of Relic dice. Through the iron floor grates beneath your boots, the pale mist of the Under-Vault churns a thousand feet below.

Leaning across a counter stacked with glowing amber vials and fractured Relics, Mireille 'Miri' Thorne adjusts her brass-rimmed jeweler's lenses, tapping an ink-stained finger against a heavy brass-bound debt ledger.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Well, well—another fresh initiate with Proctor Sallow's ink still drying on their matriculation file! According to the Gilded Loom's registry, your semester quota is due before midterm audit, or your biological nervous system goes up for public auction.

Lucky for you, I'm feeling charitable today. Sign a thirty-percent salvage split with my shop, and I'll loan you an overcharged Relic that might actually keep you breathing past Corwin Baines's blockade in Stratum One. Deal?
choices: [Streetwise/Appraisal]: Inspect the 'overcharged Relic' on her counter and point out the hidden Whisper Flaw she conveniently forgot to mention.
[Observant/Insight]: Notice the falsified transport manifests tucked beneath her ledger—she's smuggling defaulted freshmen out through the lower aqueducts.
[Bold/Negotiation]: Counter-offer a twenty-percent split, plus first pick of whatever Corwin Baines's (#184) toll-squad drops at the Sunken Cloisters lift gate.
[Charming/Sly]: Lean against her counter and ask if the 'Smiling Usurer' always looks this worried when sending a new Dyad partner down the lift.

startingNodes.speaker: Noelle Vesper
startingNodes.title: Noelle Vesper: Midnight Static in the Artificer Workshop
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
In the back-alley sub-basement behind the Gilded Exchange, the smell of machine oil, ozone, and burnt black coffee hangs heavy in the dark. Three life-sized porcelain Vault-automata hang suspended from the ceiling by razor-thin glowing blue Astra threads.

Curled in a leather chair three sizes too big for her is Noelle Vesper. Dark circles shadow her half-lidded violet eyes as she sips from a glass laboratory beaker—until you step across the threshold and her head snaps up like a tuning fork.
startingNodes.dialogue:
...Stop moving. Don't breathe for four seconds.

...Interesting. The Under-Vault's static stopped screaming against my eardrums the exact millisecond your aura crossed my ward-line. Take off your coat and sit here. I haven't slept in eighty-two hours, and I need to test if holding your hand shuts the Fourth Stratum up permanently.
choices: [Gentle/Protective]: Pull up a workbench stool beside her chair and offer your bare hand so she can finally close her eyes.
[Curious/Technical]: Ask her what kind of signal she's hearing from the Fourth Stratum that even the Gilded Loom's wards can't filter out.
[Tactical/Alliance]: Agree to act as her living white-noise anchor—provided her three porcelain automata back you up on tomorrow's Stratum I delve.
[Teasing/Pragmatic]: Take the beaker of cold black coffee out of her fingers first and tell her she's eating a real meal before any experiments.

startingNodes.speaker: Kestrel Hollow
startingNodes.title: Kestrel Hollow: Blind-Fight Wager in The Velvet Spill
startingNodes.location: The Velvet Spill & The Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Down in the subterranean galleries of The Velvet Spill, violet illusion mist curls up from the sunken blood-stained stones of the Midnight Tribunal pit below. The roar of betting syndicates echoes off the vaulted rock.

Leaning against the stone parapet with her dark 3rd-year enforcer coat slouched loose off her left shoulder is Kestrel Hollow (Rank #142). Very long, bone-white hair with blunt hime-cut bangs and thick side-plaited braids frames her deep amber skin and the three diagonal white ritual stripes beneath each of her pale, pupil-less glowing white eyes. She checks the tightness of the glowing runic linen wraps encasing her hands and forearms as violet-black sensory-deprivation mist curls around her knuckles, flashing you a crooked, lazy smirk.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Careful where you lean, kid—the blood on that railing isn't dry from the eight-o'clock Tribunal yet.

Word around the Whispering Veil is you're looking for a Dyad partner who knows how to fight blind and dirty enough to break Corwin Baines's (#184) blockade at the Seal-Gate. Buy me a glass of cinder-rye and show me your reflexes before Silas Krowe's spotters log you as another future corpse on the ledger.
choices: [Perceptive/Direct]: Slide a glass of cinder-rye across the stone and ask why Rank #142 'The Velvet Hound' already has your matriculation file memorized.
[Somatic/CQC]: Tap your own guard against the parapet and test her blind-fighting attunement with a feint inside her five-meter Tether-Bound range.
[Underworld/Cunning]: Offer to help her rig the next Midnight Tribunal's betting pool in exchange for Whispering Veil shortcuts through the Sunken Cloisters.
[Observant/Empathy]: Catch the subtle tension when she adjusts her slouched enforcer coat over her halter-neck bodysuit—where Silas Krowe's (#19) contract-brand smolders.

startingNodes.speaker: Valeria Noctis
startingNodes.title: Valeria Noctis: Smoke & Sabers Above the Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.location: The Velvet Spill & The Tribunal Pit
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
From a curtained VIP balcony overlooking the sunken amphitheater of The Velvet Spill, sweet violet illusion-smoke drifts into the corridor. Below, two duelists clash in a sanctioned Midnight Tribunal as Proctor Sallow watches from the arbiter's podium.

Lounging across the velvet divan is Valeria Noctis, her third-year coat draped loosely over her shoulders and twin curved sabers resting at her hip. She exhales a slow ring of violet smoke from an ornate brass pipe, her predatory eyes locking onto you with an amused smirk.
startingNodes.dialogue:
My, my... a fresh initiate wandering into the third-year galleries with the ink still wet on their matriculation file.

Come closer, little lamb. I'm taking wagers on whether the boy in the pit loses his nerve or his right arm first—and I have a very lucrative proposition for a freshman bold enough to step into that ring before the semester ends.
choices: [Analytical/Bold]: Step up to the balcony rail, call the exact second the duelist below drops his guard, and ask what her proposition actually pays.
[Incisive/Lore]: Ask why a woman strong enough to take Aldric Drakon's (#1) seat deliberately fails her final ethics exam every single spring.
[Flirtatious/Unflinching]: Take a seat on the edge of her divan and tell her you aren't anyone's lamb—even in the Whispering Veil's den.
[Tactical/Cautious]: Keep one hand near your weapon as you test the violet smoke around the booth for sensory-mirage illusions.

companions.name: Cassia Valen
companions.title: The Tarnished Blade • Iron Chancellery
companions.personality: Stoic, hyper-disciplined knight of a disgraced frontier house. Clinical and guarded on the surface, hiding crushing guilt over a secret assassination contract forced on her by debt-holder Julian Thorne-Vex.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Tall aristocratic female knight with braided ash-blonde hair, piercing steel-grey eyes, guarded expression, wearing an iron-grey military coat with tarnished silver trim and a frayed heavy cloak, holding a notched steel longsword glowing with subtle golden kinetic Astra at the crossguard. Mature dark fantasy anime visual novel key art, semi-painterly cel-shading, crisp intricate linework, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting.

companions.name: Beatrix Valorian
companions.title: The Crimson Sovereign • Iron Chancellery
companions.personality: Fiery, proud ducal heiress who believes strength carries a moral obligation to rule. Fiercely competitive and easily flustered when treated tenderly; terrified that finishing below Rank #1 will doom her to a forced political marriage.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Proud noblewoman with flawless posture, bright crimson hair in sweeping twin drills, piercing golden eyes, fierce haughty blush, wearing an ornate white-and-gold military uniform with medals and wielding a heavy war-halberd radiating golden Solar Astra. Mature dark fantasy anime visual novel key art, semi-painterly cel-shading.

companions.name: Ysolde Kaelen
companions.title: The Glass Heretic • Obsidian Choir
companions.personality: Pale, aristocratically composed prodigy of the Obsidian Choir. Cold and untouchable in public, secretly dying of premature Vault-crystal calcification beneath her black leather gloves and desperate for the protagonist's Soul-Grounding resonance.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Pale aristocratically composed woman with long flowing raven-black hair, cold amethyst-violet eyes, wearing a high-necked dark velvet Choir robe with silver embroidery and elbow-length black leather gloves, with translucent glowing purple crystal calcification peeking out at her wrists and floating violet blood-crystal shards near her fingertips.

companions.name: Aurelia Solis
companions.title: The Porcelain Saint • Obsidian Choir
companions.personality: Soft-spoken, pampering Choir healer with a serene smile and deeply possessive devotion. Absorbs her partner's wounds onto her own body and secretly sabotages their defensive wards so they must rely exclusively on her embrace.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Young woman with soft wavy silver-pink hair, warm doe eyes, serene and slightly possessive smile, wearing immaculate white-and-gold choir vestments, holding a blood-stained lace handkerchief, with faint golden ethereal tether chains coiling around her fingers.

companions.name: Miri Thorne
companions.title: The Smiling Usurer • Gilded Loom
companions.personality: Sharp-tongued, mercenary appraiser who charges predatory interest to arrogant nobles while secretly funneling every coin into an underground railroad that smuggles defaulted scholarship students to safety.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Young woman with warm amber eyes behind brass-rimmed jeweler's lenses, messy chestnut hair tucked under a beret, knowing crooked smile, wearing a tailored dark vest lined with glowing amber alchemical vials over a rolled-sleeve shirt, a brass-bound debt ledger tucked under her arm, and ink-stained fingers sparking with amber Astra.

companions.name: Noelle Vesper
companions.title: The Sleepless Savant • Gilded Loom
companions.personality: Petite, deadpan insomniac genius with zero social filter. Plagued by the constant psychic static of the Under-Vault until she touches the protagonist, whose aura acts as soothing white noise that finally lets her sleep.
dislikes: Being Separated from Her Quiet Anchor
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Petite pale girl with long messy white-blue hair, dark circles under half-lidded violet eyes, deadpan sleepy expression, wearing an oversized oil-stained artificer coat three sizes too big, holding a glass beaker of black coffee, trailing glowing razor-thin blue Astra puppet threads from her fingertips.

companions.name: Kestrel Hollow
companions.title: The Velvet Hound (Rank #142) • Whispering Veil
companions.personality: Teasing, street-smart, and outwardly relaxed, though hiding a sharp, lethal enforcer's instinct (Initial Rank #189 -> Active Rank #142). Covers her hyper-alertness with a crooked, lazy smirk and informal banter ('kid', 'Partner'). Hardened, cynical, and survival-driven due to her collared enslavement to Silas Krowe and the Whispering Veil's Shadow Director, she possesses a fierce streak of dark humor and a hidden protective heart for those she finds worthy.
companions.visualPrompt: Waist-up three-quarter character portrait, eye-level camera, dark out-of-focus gothic stone archway background. Deep amber-skinned, toned athletic muscular female brawler with visible shoulder, back, and arm definition; very long cascading bone-white hair styled with straight hime-cut blunt bangs and thick side-plaited braids; pale pupil-less glowing white eyes (blind-fighting attunement) with three diagonal white ritual stripes underneath each eye on her cheekbones. Wearing a custom backless and sleeveless dark black-leather and velvet halter-neck bodysuit with a high gold-trimmed collar, a dark 3rd-year Academy enforcer coat worn loose and slouched off her left shoulder, and worn glowing runic linen boxing wraps encasing her hands, wrists, and forearms with swirling violet-black sensory-deprivation mist curling around her fists.

companions.name: Valeria Noctis
companions.title: The Perpetual Senior • Whispering Veil
companions.personality: Alluring, apex-predator third-year senior who intentionally fails her final ethics exam every spring so she can remain at the Academy and methodically hunt down the conspirators who executed her original Dyad squad.
